name: crime_rng_seeded
description: A real cRZRandomSuper (foundations 6.1: MT19937 with the non-standard seeding, doubles at 24-bit precision: uniform = f32(f32(int32(w) x 2^-32) + 0.5), range = f32(f32(u x f32(b - a)) + a), uint(n) = (w x n) >> 32) drives AddCrimes and SelectProp, so the draws are checked against the 6.1 sequences rather than a scripted stub. Lot 1 (zone 1, wealth 1, purpose 1, condition 1) under police 255 with the shipped attenuation curve: p = 0.5; every attempt draws u, p > u stops, otherwise r = range(0, 20) walks the candidates Generic 0 (0x01), Fighting 3 (0x03), Car Theft 3 (0x08), Mugging 2 (0x0A), Flashing 4 (0x10), Graffiti 4 (0x11), Pie Throwing 4 (0x12). Then SelectProp over three generic props (crime ID 0) on a cell without a lot draws uint(3) from the same generator. Expected values from an independent Python model of 6.1 (checked first against the foundations test-14 words: seed 1 -> 0xD3F6B9E5, 0xEF284157, 0x0D3639C7; seed 4357 -> 0xAAE64AC3, ...): seed 1, 12 attempts -> stop, stop, Graffiti, stop, Mugging, stop, Flashing, Graffiti, Graffiti, stop, stop, stop (5 crimes), then props 2, 1, 0, 0; seed 2024 -> stop, Flashing, Flashing, stop, stop, stop, Car Theft, Pie Throwing, stop, stop, stop, Graffiti (5 crimes), then props 0, 0, 1, 2.
